It NEVER decides what/when by scanning the goal for keywords, and never does the model's creative work. 2. *Efficient perception* — structured element list w/ live state (disabled/selected/focused) + set-of-marks badges + labeled coord grid on a downscaled shot + nav scrape. Fast text-only path vs slow vision path chosen by *the model's own stated confidence*. Change-detector skips re-encode when `sig(screen_t)=sig(screen_{t−1})`. Credit is *surfaced as an ordering, never argmax'd*: `Surface(o_t) = top-k_σ rel(σ,u_t)·(1+Q(σ,u_t))`. Model authors its own operators; kept only if novel + measured `Q>0`. Ordinary use IS the training signal, captured in the *identical byte-level contract* later used to train the fast action head. Proven-after-*twice* before commit.
